16: 	ID hcl.Expression

18: 	To hcl.Expression

33: func decodeImportBlock(block *hcl.Block) (*Import, hcl.Diagnostics) {
34: 	var diags hcl.Diagnostics
35: 	imp := &Import{
36: 		DeclRange: block.DefRange,
37: 	}
38: 
39: 	content, moreDiags := block.Body.Content(importBlockSchema)
40: 	diags = append(diags, moreDiags...)

44: 	}

47: 		toExpr, jsDiags := unwrapJSONRefExpr(attr.Expr)
48: 		diags = diags.Extend(jsDiags)
49: 		if diags.HasErrors() {
50: 			return imp, diags
51: 		}

53: 		imp.To = toExpr
54: 
55: 		addr, toDiags := parseConfigResourceFromExpression(imp.To)
56: 		diags = diags.Extend(toDiags.ToHCL())
57: 
58: 		if addr.Resource.Mode != addrs.ManagedResourceMode {
59: 			diags = append(diags, &hcl.Diagnostic{
60: 				Severity: hcl.DiagError,
61: 				Summary:  "Invalid import address",

63: 				Subject:  attr.Range.Ptr(),
64: 			})
65: 		}

67: 		imp.ToResource = addr

71: 		imp.ForEach = attr.Expr
72: 	}

74: 	if attr, exists := content.Attributes["provider"]; exists {

115: // block's "to" to the configuration address before the full instance
116: // expressions are evaluated.
117: func parseConfigResourceFromExpression(expr hcl.Expression) (addrs.ConfigResource, tfdiags.Diagnostics) {

119: 	if hcdiags.HasErrors() {
120: 		return addrs.ConfigResource{}, tfdiags.Diagnostics(nil).Append(hcdiags)

131: // unwrapJSONRefExpr takes a string expression from a JSON configuration,
132: // and re-evaluates the string as HCL. If the expression is not JSON, the
133: // original expression is returned directly.
134: func unwrapJSONRefExpr(expr hcl.Expression) (hcl.Expression, hcl.Diagnostics) {
135: 	if !hcljson.IsJSONExpression(expr) {
136: 		return expr, nil
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	// We can abuse the hcl json api and rely on the fact that calling
140: 	// Value on a json expression with no EvalContext will return the
141: 	// raw string. We can then parse that as normal hcl syntax, and
142: 	// continue with the decoding.
143: 	v, diags := expr.Value(nil)
144: 	if diags.HasErrors() {
145: 		return nil, diags
146: 	}
147: 
148: 	// the JSON representation can only be a string
149: 	if v.Type() != cty.String {
150: 		diags = diags.Append(&hcl.Diagnostic{
151: 			Severity: hcl.DiagError,
152: 			Summary:  "Invalid reference expression",
153: 			Detail:   "A single reference string is required.",
154: 			Subject:  expr.Range().Ptr(),
155: 		})
156: 
157: 		return nil, diags
158: 	}
159: 
160: 	rng := expr.Range()
161: 	expr, ds := hclsyntax.ParseExpression([]byte(v.AsString()), rng.Filename, rng.Start)
162: 	diags = diags.Extend(ds)
163: 	return expr, diags
164: }

167: // which must be a resource instance, but may contain limited variables with
168: // index expressions. Since we only need the ConfigResource to connect the
169: // import to the configuration, we skip any index expressions.
170: func exprToResourceTraversal(expr hcl.Expression) (hcl.Traversal, hcl.Diagnostics) {
171: 	var trav hcl.Traversal
172: 	var diags hcl.Diagnostics
173: 
174: 	switch e := expr.(type) {
175: 	case *hclsyntax.RelativeTraversalExpr:
176: 		t, d := exprToResourceTraversal(e.Source)
177: 		diags = diags.Extend(d)
178: 		trav = append(trav, t...)
179: 		trav = append(trav, e.Traversal...)
180: 
181: 	case *hclsyntax.ScopeTraversalExpr:
182: 		// a static reference, we can just append the traversal
183: 		trav = append(trav, e.Traversal...)
184: 
185: 	case *hclsyntax.IndexExpr:
186: 		// Get the collection from the index expression, we don't need the
187: 		// index for a ConfigResource
188: 		t, d := exprToResourceTraversal(e.Collection)
189: 		diags = diags.Extend(d)
190: 		if diags.HasErrors() {
191: 			return nil, diags
192: 		}
193: 		trav = append(trav, t...)
194: 
195: 	default:
196: 		// if we don't recognise the expression type (which means we are likely
197: 		// dealing with a test mock), try and interpret this as an absolute
198: 		// traversal
199: 		t, d := hcl.AbsTraversalForExpr(e)
200: 		diags = diags.Extend(d)
201: 		trav = append(trav, t...)
202: 	}
203:

205: }

219: 	traversal, hd := hcl.AbsTraversalForExpr(expr)
220: 	toDiags = toDiags.Append(hd)
221: 	to, td := addrs.ParseAbsResourceInstance(traversal)
222: 	toDiags = toDiags.Append(td)
223: 	return to, !toDiags.HasErrors()
